STEP 1 - Scene: A light meal on a white round plate: sliced cooked chicken breast (or pale meat) on the left and sliced cucumber on the right. Photographed from above (near top-down view), with the plate filling most of the frame.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The plate looks like a dinner plate, roughly 26 cm in diameter. Area = 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: (1) cooked chicken breast slices, about 5-6 pieces; (2) cucumber slices, about 12-14 pieces, some half-moons, plus a few small rounds.

STEP 4 - Area: Chicken covers about 12% of the plate (~64 cm^2). Cucumber covers about 14% (~74 cm^2). Total food ≈ 26% of the vessel, which is plausible for a partly filled plate.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Chicken: 64 cm^2 x ~1.2 cm (pieces are thick, stacked) ≈ 77 ml.
- Cucumber: 74 cm^2 x ~1.5 cm (sliced rounds and half-moons piled up) ≈ 111 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Chicken: 77 ml x 0.95 ≈ 73 g.
- Cucumber: 111 ml x 0.6 ≈ 67 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Chicken breast, cooked: 73 g x 165 kcal/100 g ≈ 120 kcal.
- Cucumber, raw: 67 g x 15 kcal/100 g ≈ 10 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 140 g of food with about 130 kcal fits a small, lean meal of a few chicken slices and cucumber on a large plate. No visible oil or dressing was detected, so none is added.
